\begin{document}
The occupations of a level at $\pm\epsilon$ with $\beta>0$ add up to one.
\iffalse
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta\epsilon}+1} = \frac{1}{e^{-\beta\epsilon}+1} .
\label{eq:old}
\end{equation}
\fi
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta\epsilon}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\beta\epsilon}+1} = 1 .
\label{eq:new}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
